label: Spatial program checkpoint
title: Editable spatial programs survive two lifts, including autonomous transport
kind: Exact native program realization and guard rescue
summary: A five-symbol radius-nine interpreter stores Rail-program leaf bits in physical cells. A separate guard admits all ECA starting programs, preserves one-cell edits through recursive lifts, and supports autonomous state-gated program transport.
takeaway: Separating source and guard programs rescues a failed boundary choice. Native program inheritance is constructive under explicit role, layout, and wrapper budgets.
